company.shortDescription: Carwah is Saudi Arabia’s leading digital car rental platform, offering 110,000+ cars from 1,300 offices across 45 cities.
company.description:
Carwah is Saudi Arabia’s leading digital car rental platform, connecting users with over 110,000 cars from 1,300+ rental offices across 45 cities and airports. Launched in 2018, Carwah was built to make car rental as simple and convenient as pizza ordering — eliminating long waits, uncertainty, and limited options. Through its user-friendly app, Carwah allows customers to browse, compare, book, and receive their rental cars with flexible daily, weekly, and long-term options.

A key innovation is Carwah’s Cloud Yard service — a virtual fleet hub enabling car delivery and pick-up in record time, reducing operational costs for rental companies and offering customers a frictionless experience. Carwah serves both individuals and corporate clients with dedicated B2B solutions and custom leasing programs.

Carwah is reshaping the car rental industry across Saudi Arabia and the GCC with a strong focus on technology, customer service, and continuous innovation. Every present has a future — and Carwah is the future of car rental.
